confirmation.limitation: Confidence intervals describe the declared finite distribution; passed integrity does not imply target attainment.

native.limitation: Sensor/frame/command/metric and generated-world consistency only. Native dynamics and within-tick measured wheel-rate maxima are not replayed; traffic/collisions unassessed.

runtime.limitation: Finite observed timings only; no formal WCET guarantee or isolated architecture attribution.

training.limitation: Saved optimizer origin/hash and final step count checked; stochastic optimizer updates are not rerun.

reconstruction: Concatenate each source file pieces in listed offset order. All byte counts, piece SHA256, reconstructed source SHA256 and ZIP CRCs are checked.
